title: Lazy Vegan Tart
description: A delicious and easy-to-make vegan tart filled with a sweet and tangy filling.

ingredients.name: Maple Syrup
ingredients.notes: grade B for a stronger flavor

instructions: Roll out the tart crust and place it in a 9-inch tart pan.
In a blender or food processor, combine the lazy filling ingredients and blend until smooth.
Pour the filling into the tart crust.
Drizzle the lemon juice and maple syrup over the filling.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
